name: wiki-guides-republish-v2
description: Republish after v2 (scripted; R14): a set published at 1.0 and refreshed for 1.1 (settings marked retake). A headless /user-guides:wiki-guides release=1.1 go-ahead=yes retakes only settings, reads it back, swaps it in, and republishes: exactly settings.png is replaced, and exactly the pages whose text the refresh changed reach their next version, with a 1.1 version message (a release alone changes no page).
